author: Dushyant Chetiwal
name: RD-E8 Looped Distillation (Zero-Codebook Spherical Shell-E8 Lattice Codec)
blurb: 53.2M unique / 75.5M effective looped Transformer compressed to 2.19 bpp via a bit-exact zero-codebook Spherical Shell-E8 lattice codec (FWHT + Conway-Sloane E8 + enumerative sphere rank/unrank) and Rate-Distortion KL+CE distillation. Achieves 1.107200 val_bpb (sliding, zero TTT) and 1.099024 val_bpb (score-first LoRA TTT) across all 47,853,343 canonical CaseOps val tokens in 15,828,534 B total (15.83 MB), beating the #1 unlimited-compute 1-bit entry (1.1239) by -0.0249 bpb.
